candidates.title: Targeted murders, weapon attacks raise alarm in Hyderabad
candidates.excerpt: A series of recent murders in Hyderabad has drawn attention to targeted attacks involving knives and sickles. Police say the cases appear unrelated, with motives ranging from personal rivalry to vehicle theft, while investigators rely on CCTV footage and forensic evidence

candidates.title: U.S. House passes Russia sanctions bill seeking to impose up to 100% tariffs on India, others
candidates.excerpt: The Bill, which will now be sent U.S. President Donald Trump for his signature, could result in significant U.S. tariffs on India

candidates.title: Jharkhand Congress takes out protest march demanding separate OBC column in Census 2027
candidates.excerpt: A 10-member Congress delegation submit memorandum to Governor; assert that obtaining accurate population data for the OBC community would strengthen the factual basis for policy formulation and decisions regarding representation

candidates.title: BJP MPs raise concerns over slow pace of infrastructure projects in Odisha
candidates.excerpt: Nabrangpur MP Balabhadra Majhi, Bolangir MP Sangeeta Kumari Singh Deo and Kantabanji MLA Laxman Bag’s letters is said to put the Mohan Charan Majhi government in an uncomfortable position

candidates.title: Death penalty for all 10 convicts in 2013 Jhiram Valley Maoist attack case
candidates.excerpt: Twenty seven people, including senior Congress leaders Vidya Charan Shukla, Nand Kumar Patel, and Mahendra Karma, were killed in the attack on May 25, 2013

candidates.title: Farmer, daughter die in murder-suicide bid in Khammam; son critical
candidates.excerpt: A 44-year-old farmer allegedly poisoned himself and his two children at a leased farm in NTR district. He and his 14-year-old daughter died, while his 10-year-old son was shifted to Hyderabad in critical condition. The motive remains unknown

candidates.title: Maharashtra farmers hold protests, seek drought aid; doing everything possible, won’t let them suffer: CM
Uttar Pradesh ATS arrests Tamil Nadu youth for allegedly planning terror activities
candidates.excerpt: Maqsood Ali, who was allegedly in touch with Pakistani hackers and had developed a secure communication network for others like him, was arrested from Coimbatore with the assistance of Tamil Nadu ATS

candidates.title: Trump lauds India's crackdown on poppy farming; lists 23 major drug transit nations
candidates.excerpt: He urged China to take stronger action to stem the flow of precursor chemicals used to produce fentanyl, methamphetamine and other synthetic drugs

candidates.title: Himachal’s policy uncompromising toward those involved in illegal drug trade: CM Sukhu
candidates.excerpt: He also stated the government would “adopt a compassionate approach towards young people who had already fallen into addiction and extend every possible support to help them recover"

candidates.title: War-damaged Gaza building collapses, killing 20 people sheltering inside
candidates.excerpt: Raed Al-Dahshan, the director of Gaza City’s civil defence service, said ⁠at least 10 families lived in the collapsed building and there was still hope of finding survivors

candidates.title: Assam’s Lok Sabha bypoll could define contours of Opposition politics in the State
candidates.excerpt: Nagaon is the first major face-off between the principal combatants, BJP and Congress, since the former’s crushing sweep in the April Assembly election with 102 out of 126 seats for the National Democratic Alliance
